svg.aria-label: 4 copies of the 6 by 6 plate colored by temperature. Step 0: top row 100, all else 0. Step 1: the 4 cells of row 1 are 25. Step 2: row 1 reads 31.25, 37.5, 37.5, 31.25 and row 2 reads 6.25 in each of its 4 interior cells. Step 100: rows 1 to 4 read 45.45, 59.47, 59.47, 45.45 / 22.35, 32.95, 32.95, 22.35 / 10.98, 17.05, 17.05, 10.98 / 4.55, 7.20, 7.20, 4.55.
svg.text: Each step replaces every interior cell by the mean of its old neighbors.
